rationale: Builds on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a compact structural change: earlier recurrent tail passes and their carry refresh are capped below the deepest pass, keeping the strongest recurrence on the most export-sensitive final block while reducing over-rotation in earlier recurrent blocks. This stays compile-stable, near-byte-neutral, and directly targets the close-miss capped-profile idea instead of another scalar-only sweep.
title: Depth-Capped Reverse Tail Recurrence
